subject: Discovery follow-up: technical deep dive & next steps

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 15:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: technical deep dive & next steps

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the context on your ingestion pipeline and where latency and cost are showing up in the ML inference path. Quick recap and proposed next steps below: 

Recap from today's call:
- Primary goal: reduce inference tail latency and cost for batch and near-real-time scoring.
- Current infra: Kubernetes w/ custom batching, running on single-GPU nodes.
- Top concerns: latency spikes during peak, token-level cost, and model version stability.

Proposed next step: Technical deep dive (60 min) where we can:
- Walk through sample traffic and sequence-length distribution
- Review model variants and quantization tradeoffs
- Discuss deployment options (Hosted API vs Dedicated GPU pools) and a mutual action plan

Availability: I can send a calendar invite for any of these options — please pick what works best for your team: 
- Wed, Jul 8, 10:00–11:00 PT (my first choice)
- Thu, Jul 9, 9:00–10:00 PT
- Fri, Jul 10, 11:00–12:00 PT

Can you also confirm the attendee list (names + roles) and whether you prefer Zoom or Google Meet? I can include a separate Tech Solutions Engineer from our side (Marissa) and Rafael (solutions architect) for the deep dive.

Attaching a one-pager with a quick product summary. I will follow up with a calendar invite once we confirm time and attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF)]
